Messages.Author: Ma...@worldcom.com
Messages.Body:
This is from a friend I play Vamp with.

Here's the question. It's regarding a Sabbat card called "Slaughtering the
Herd." It's a Dominate action card, but in the description of the card's
effect, there are Potence symbols instead of Dominate symbols. Does this
mean you have to have both disciplines to use the card (not unreasonable,
as the card is pretty kick ass), or is it just a misprint?

Thanks in advance. If you could email me as well as post it, i'd appreciate
it.

>M

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Ma...@worldcom.com wrote:
> Here's the question. It's regarding a Sabbat card called "Slaughtering the
> Herd." It's a Dominate action card, but in the description of the card's
> effect, there are Potence symbols instead of Dominate symbols. Does this
> mean you have to have both disciplines to use the card (not unreasonable,
> as the card is pretty kick ass), or is it just a misprint?

Just a misprint. It requires Dominate. The potence symbols should
be read as dominate symbols.
